data.description: The data object contains the details of the action taken.

id.description: A unique identifier for the action taken.

interactionId.description: A unique identifier for each interaction or contact within the contact center.

orgId.description: The organization ID to which the agent belongs.

agentId.description: The identifier for the agent whose burnout index has been calculated.

clientId.description: The name of the client initiating the action related to the agent burnout index. The name is limited to a maximum of 20 characters.

actionType.description: Specifies the type of action initiated based on the agent burnout index

actionDateTime.description: The Epoch timestamp indicating the precise time at which the action was executed.

createdDateTime.description: The Epoch timestamp indicating the time when the action was created.

trackingId.description: The unique tracking ID for this request.
